lines: Patient: Haverty, Russell K.     Visit: 09/24/2026     Provider: Elena Szymanski, MD

pages.title: Hospital discharge summary
lines: Dx: Acute decompensated HF w/ reduced EF, new onset. Cardiomyopathy, non-ischemic.
Course: Presented w/ 2 wks progressive DOE, orthopnea, 15 lb wt gain. BNP 3,900. Diuresed IV furosemide, net -7 L.
LHC 07/10: nonobstructive CAD (RCA 30%, LAD luminal irregularities). No intervention. No prior MI hx.
CMR 07/11: LVEF 24%, LVEDV index 138 mL/m2, mid-wall septal LGE; no subendocardial or transmural LGE. Pattern consistent with dilated NICM.
Meds at discharge (new): sacubitril-valsartan, metoprolol succinate, spironolactone, dapagliflozin - all initiated 07/12/2026 at discharge after diuresis complete. Amlodipine discontinued.

pages.title: EP pre-procedure H&P
lines: Date: 10/01/2026   Patient: Russell K. Haverty   Admit: 10/08/2026 (inpatient)
Procedure: single chamber transvenous ICD, CPT 33249.
Indication: Primary prevention. NICM, LVEF 26% (TTE 9/24), NYHA II, on GDMT since July hospitalization.
No prior MI, PCI or CABG.
Expected LOS 2 midnights. Reasons: severe OSA requiring CPAP monitoring after sedation; BMI 36 with prior difficult IV access; CKD 3a requiring post-procedure BMP.
Contraindication review: no dementia, no cancer or other condition limiting life expectancy to under a year, no AF, hemodynamically stable outpatient. None identified.
